_comment: Fill these in, then run: python3 tools/build.py. Values still in [BRACKETS] or containing <username> count as unfilled: the build warns and marks every page DRAFT. Everything in this file is published; no secrets, IDs or keys. siteUrl is the origin only (no path), e.g. https://abdullahfoysal.github.io. basePath is the project-site prefix. privacyPolicyUrl is the full public URL, e.g. https://abdullahfoysal.github.io/arrow-escape/privacy-policy/.
